description: Define a KPI (west element): how its value is computed, in which system and where it is read, who answers for the number, how often a reading is due. Read it before taking a reading, so every agent computes the KPI the same way. Each field given replaces the stored one, null clears it, fields not given are kept.

formula.description: How the value is computed, e.g. "active accounts / signed accounts, at month end"

frequency.description: How often a reading is due

source_ref.description: Where in it: a report, a saved query, a URL

source_system.description: The system the value is read in (e.g. "HubSpot", "Pennylane")

name: set_kpi_definition
